A.status: Access + emergency response  ·  pad off NW Celilo Ln (W)  ·  meet at the T, 22 m away  ·  stage on the collector  ·  ambulance fits the pad  ·  3 ways out  ·  no turnaround
A.considerations:
Arrive on the collector (likely NW Skyline Ranch Rd, verify) and turn onto NW Celilo Ln at the T; the drive is 22 m (73 ft) from the T on the left. The T is the meet / ground-guide point, not a rated LZ.
Driveway pad: 17.2 m (56 ft) street edge to garage face, 6.2 m (20 ft) wide at the mouth. An ambulance fits; there is no turnaround. Patient path: front entry / garage to the pad.
Celilo is 11.5 m (38 ft) curb to curb with cars parked on both sides, so do not stage there. Stage in the collector curb / bike lane E of the T along the N frontage.
Three ways out: the collector NW, the collector SE, and Celilo S/SW. The rear (E) side is reachable on foot across the N strip and lawn; gate status unknown.
A.recommendations:
Back the ambulance onto the pad (nose out toward Celilo), or nose in and reverse out with a spotter. Engines and ladders work from the street or the collector.
Keep the T clear for ground-guiding and agree any LZ with the agency. If fire is in the E/SE tract, evacuate W via Celilo or along the collector, away from the fuel.
Add a Knox box / lockbox (none visible in imagery; verify), confirm whether a side gate exists to the rear yard, and post house numbers visible from both streets.
With no cameras, dispatch has no visual on arrival (see S). Verify the collector name and the front-entry location on a site visit.

F.status: WUI edge E/SE  ·  nearest hydrant 19 m (WFH005944)  ·  3 City hydrants within 115 m  ·  no pool / pond for drafting
F.considerations:
Directly E/SE is an undeveloped tract of native juniper, pine and sagebrush, the WUI edge and the heaviest fuel load.
An irrigated lawn buffers the E/SE side. Junipers stand 5-10 m east of the lawn; no trees touch or overhang the roof.
Side walls are 3-6 m from the neighbour at 3261 (S): ember and radiant exposure in both directions. Construction lots lie W/SW.
Hydrants (City GIS, 6 in): WFH005944 19 m NNW, WFH006140 78 m SW, WFH005943 114 m E. No pool, hot tub or pond visible.
F.recommendations:
Lay in from WFH005944: position the first engine in the collector curb lane beside it (dashed box), clear of the T.
Keep the lawn irrigated and extend a lean, clean 0-30 ft zone on the E/SE; limb up and thin the junipers nearest the lawn.
Use ember-resistant vents and keep the N/W gravel strips free of bark mulch against the walls (verify materials on site).
Confirm hydrant positions and flow on site; GIS points are approximate.
